opportunities.name: Research topic to paper note
opportunities.description: For a topic and year, run arXiv advanced search, open the top result, look up its title on Semantic Scholar for author and citation count, and save a note.
steps: Enter the topic in the search term field
Tick the date filter, choose specific year, and enter the year
Click Search and open the top result
Search the paper title on Semantic Scholar and open the paper
Read the first author and citation count

opportunities.name: Case law lookup to statute note
opportunities.description: For a Supreme Court case name, find it on CourtListener, look up the related US Code statute on Cornell LII, and save a note with the citation, decision date and statute.
steps: Search the case name in CourtListener case law
Open the matching case and read the citation and decision date
Search the related statute on Cornell LII and open it
